title: Question card fold · B · Peek (decided 19 Nov)
intro: The user picked B, the designer's recommendation (Claude Design round 1, canvas “Clubmate · Question card fold”). Rules: rules.md next to this page.

The card has three heights: full, peek and bar. Peek is the default on the phone and iPad; the Mac opens full and folds with ⌥Q. While a question is pending the composer is the current question's Other, so nothing can be sent past it.
